The '''Greelwood Saber''' was a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] crafted by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Oorrl Morm/Legends|Oorrl Morm]], an [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] serving the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Crafting the hilt from a lacquered piece of [[Greel wood|greel-wood]], the lightsaber was powered by a [[Adegan crystal/Legends|pontite]] [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystal]] mined from the [[Crystal Caves (Ossus)/Legends|crystal caves]] in the [[Eocho Mountains/Legends|Eocho Mountains]]. The lightsaber was meant to symbolize the Order's principle of defense rather than offense. After Morm's death, the lightsaber was interred within a vault in the [[Chamber of Antiquities/Legends|Chamber of Antiquities]].<ref name="NoP" />
